faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Answers to the questions we hear most about charging, licensing, and local support.

items.q: Can I charge a Linktour L6 or L7 at home?
items.a: Yes — both models charge from a standard household wall outlet, so no dedicated wallbox is required. The on-board charger accepts up to 2 kW (L6) or 3.3 kW (L7) of AC power, so a full charge takes about 4 hours for the L6 and 4.5 hours for the L7.

items.q: How long does a full charge take?
items.a: The L6's 7.2 kWh battery charges from 0 to 100% in about 4 hours at 2 kW. The L7's larger 12.96 kWh battery takes about 4.5 hours at 3.3 kW. Both use AC charging.

items.q: What's the driving range on a single charge?
items.a: The L6 covers up to 120 km and the L7 up to 180 km on a full charge (WMTC test cycle). Real-world range varies with speed, temperature, and load.

items.q: What's the difference between the L6 and L7 classification?
items.a: The L6 is registered as an L6e light quadricycle and the L7 as an L7e heavy quadricycle — official EU vehicle categories with different weight, power, and speed limits. L7e permits higher performance than L6e.

items.q: Do I need a special driver's license?
items.a: No special license is needed: a standard Category B (car) license covers both models. The Linktour L6 is an L6e light quadricycle (max 45 km/h), so it can be driven with either a Category AM (moped) or a Category B license. The Linktour L7 is an L7e heavy quadricycle and requires a Category B license.

items.q: Are there speed limits for these vehicles?
items.a: Yes. The L6 has a top speed of 45 km/h, the limit for the L6e light quadricycle category. The L7 reaches 90 km/h.

items.q: Who handles service and warranty in North Macedonia?
items.a: AVC-SM CO., LTD., with 24+ years of experience in electric mobility, batteries, and electronics, provides local warranty support, battery diagnostics, cell balancing, and repair — backed by official parts through our partnership with Linktour.

items.q: What happens if something goes wrong with the battery?
items.a: AVC-SM's technical team has specialized equipment and trained personnel for battery diagnostics, testing, balancing, and repair, so battery issues are handled locally rather than requiring you to ship the vehicle abroad.

items.q: How does import and delivery work?
items.a: BetaSped, our logistics partner with 30+ years in freight forwarding, handles import, customs, and delivery — so every vehicle arrives through an established, professional supply chain.

replies.suspension: The L6 can be driven with a Category AM or B license, and the L7 requires Category B. Whether a suspension, revocation, or driving ban also covers a given category depends on the terms of that decision, so we can't advise on it. Please check with the authority that issued it before driving.
replies.license: No special license is needed: a standard Category B (car) license covers both models. The L6 (L6e light quadricycle, max 45 km/h) can also be driven with a Category AM (moped) license, while the L7 (L7e heavy quadricycle) requires Category B. For minimum age requirements, our specialist team can confirm what applies to you.
replies.charging: Both the L6 and L7 charge from a standard household wall outlet — no dedicated wallbox required. The L6's 7.2 kWh battery charges fully (0–100%) in about 4 hours at 2 kW, and the L7's 12.96 kWh battery in about 4.5 hours at 3.3 kW.
replies.compare: The L6 is an L6e light quadricycle built for tight city streets: 7.2 kWh battery, 45 km/h top speed, 120 km range, drivable with a Category AM or B license. The L7 is an L7e heavy quadricycle: 12.96 kWh battery, 90 km/h top speed, 180 km range, and requires a Category B license.
replies.service: AVC-SM, with 24+ years of experience in electric mobility and batteries, handles local warranty support, battery diagnostics, cell balancing, and repair in North Macedonia — backed by official Linktour parts.
replies.testDrive: You can book a test drive right from this site — use the "Book Test Drive" button in the menu or hero section, or the quick action below.
replies.pricing: Operating costs are low thanks to electric propulsion and compact design, but exact pricing is still being finalized. Join the waitlist or place a pre-order deposit and we'll follow up with introductory pricing as soon as it's confirmed.
replies.logistics: BetaSped, our logistics partner with 30+ years of freight-forwarding experience, handles import and customs — vehicles arrive in Macedonia through an established, professional supply chain.
replies.fallback: I can help with charging, comparing the L6 and L7, local warranty and service, or booking a test drive — what would you like to know? For anything specific, our specialist team can help via the "Ask a Specialist" form.
